Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You detail your cost pressures here and have emphasised volume in our reviews—it sounds like dependable business matters alongside cost recovery. Please share your cost-breakdown XLSX so we can establish a transparent basis for a longer-term agreement. How could a longer commitment translate into a lower base price?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.77 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We welcome your commitment to 23,700 units over 24 months, which allows us to offer a more favorable base price.
For a contract of this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price is not sustainable over two years.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.
Please send us the competing offer you mentioned.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You link a better base price to our commitment while insisting on index protection; it sounds like dependable business and protection from alloy-cost swings are what make a longer agreement worthwhile for you. We want that certainty to translate into a competitive base price, with a clear separation between base costs and alloy risk. How can you reflect the value of dependable business and risk protection more fully in your base price?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.86 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
